updates.title: VAICOM Community Edition for DCS World
updates.releasenotes:
BETA 3.0.9.18
- Adds AI_ATC Andersen 2.0 dynamic keywords to database
- Add UH-1H Single PTT logic by Sleighzy
- Fix crash with UH-1H when using Single PTT enhanced mode Also Fix module detection error
- Add a check in updateradiosSRS.cs to prevent crash if no Radio detected
- Add Kneeboard commands and functionality for Show Next Tab and Show Previous Tab
- Fix Kneeboard command Clear Notes will now clear notes regardless of dictate mode
- Fix UH-1H UHF Radio not switching in cockpit frequency
- Add Phase 1 of AH-64D George AI implementation
- Add remaining George AI contextual commands
- New George AI keywords You must reset your Keywords!
 -Next Search and Next Point now closes George AI Overlay
- New Direct Weapon Selection routine for George AI
- New Multi add and target track routine for George AI
- Adds Ah-64 George Ai inflight Weapons change functionality if De Wahzed by George on ammunition zero
- Removes many development log items from debug logging
- Adds Sentry 25 Campaign M02, M03, M04, M10 and M11 Dynamic keywords for testing
- Minor keyword change
- Fix broken George payload logic and not require log file creation
